invariants: invocation sequences are contiguous one-based integers
every invocation binds run, lock, closure, supervisor, task, sequence, and resource profile
timeouts and OOM require nonzero exit, process-group kill, and verified cleanup
observed lifecycle evidence requires verified cleanup
